How to Ride
🎫 Tickets & Smart Card
Smart Card: ₹100 deposit + ₹50 min balance = 10% off every ride. Buy at any counter or use the Namma Metro App for QR tickets. UPI accepted at kiosks.
💰 Fares
₹10 min · ₹90 max · One ticket covers entire journey including all line changes — no re-entry fee.
🕐 Timings
First train ~5:00 AM · Last ~11:00 PM
Peak hrs (8–10 AM, 5–8 PM): every 3–5 min
Off-peak: 7–12 min
🔄 Majestic Interchange
Purple (underground) ↔ Green (elevated). ~5 min walk. Go to Gate 5 for Purple. No extra ticket.
🔄 RV Road Interchange
Green ↔ Yellow on the same level. Follow the signs — easiest interchange!
🟡 Yellow Line Tips
Board at RV Road from Green Line. Great for BTM, HSR, Electronic City, Infosys, Biocon.
📱 Apps
Namma Metro App – tickets & planner
